title: Stop after the same fix fails twice
statement: When the same fix has failed twice, stop and review the process instead of applying it again.
example: Re-authoring the items that had leaked raised the leak rate from 0.615 to 0.812; new item designs in the next round lowered it to 0.615.
detail: A bounded repair controller for a Grade 3 course allows at most three attempts, stops earlier after two identical ineffective remedies, and sends two identical failures to process review rather than another retry. In a Grade 3 item pool's regeneration log, re-authoring the items that had leaked to a passage-blind solver raised the leak rate from 0.615 to 0.812, and it fell back to 0.615 in the next round, when new item designs landed.
